phase.name: post-preview FEC lifecycle merged; MTU follow-up next
phase.reason: FEC lifecycle work is merged, but MTU negotiation/per-association budget enforcement and oversize handling are not fully closed, and known repository-wide CI red checks remain.

merged_fec_lifecycle.behavior: Incomplete heavy FEC recovery is bounded by a 2 second absolute deadline. Expired heavy state is compacted into retired state so parity/reconstruction payload is released while late systematic first-delivery and duplicate suppression remain preserved.

evidence.reconstruct_success_delta: within -0.40% to +0.15% across the two clean pairs
evidence.cpu_claim: Do not claim CPU optimization; LINK CPU was effectively neutral/slightly higher by about 0.001-0.002 core.
evidence.excluded_repeat: Third repeat pair is non-authoritative because bounded-r3 had one skipped send slot and stats-r3 had 855 UDP RcvbufErrors.

already_present: Canonical path-budget derivation exists and should be reused.
DataPlane FEC wire ownership corruption is fixed separately and must not be reinterpreted as an MTU arithmetic bug.
Recent tested full-stack combinations did not reproduce transport-integrity corruption.
unresolved: Repair stale server-mux MTU range tests that treat 1461/1501 as universally illegal inner MTUs.
Audit LINK_INIT -> policy validation -> association activation and enforce the actual carrier/FEC/Game-derived maximum before activation.
Enforce MTU per association on shared server paths rather than with one global inner-MTU assumption.
Define and test explicit behavior for an over-budget backend/application datagram so Outbound error cannot silently leave an apparently active association with its backend read loop gone.
Run real FEC + native DTLS + FakeTCP boundary validation after the enforcement fix.
guardrails: Do not change the FEC decoder payload upper bound from 1372 to 1428.
Do not widen MTU to hide ownership/framing failures.
Do not duplicate subtract-constant formulas; reuse canonical path-MTU derivation.
Distinguish protocol representation bounds from actual transport/association bounds.
Do not silently shrink a peer proposal unless the existing protocol explicitly negotiates and confirms it.
Do not modify the published preview tag.

known_ci.classification: pre-existing relative to bounded-FEC behavior commit
known_ci.generic_ci: Stale MTU assertions; targeted FEC/LINK packages passed in focused validation.
known_ci.faketcp_native: Existing SACK/RACK 10% loss smoke requires 1000/1000. Stats-only parent produced 991/1000 and later FEC head produced 986/1000 after unit/build passed.
known_ci.apply_server_negotiated_mtu_fix: Historical/stale MTU workflow; not authority for FEC lifecycle regression classification.

continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Merged PR #13 into release/20260914-fec-baseline at f8951a7065001a0850e178dd0bfb182cb4973ae2, then wrote the substantive FEC/MTU handoff record at b273ede100ed4284dc2189f2c2e1164ceb2fa19e.
continuation_cursor.current_task: Complete the post-preview MTU follow-up as a separate engineering phase. FEC lifecycle work is merged and should not be reopened without deterministic evidence.
continuation_cursor.why_now: The release baseline explicitly says MTU is not fully fixed. The remaining risk is not the old FEC ownership corruption; it is stale range tests plus missing proof/enforcement that negotiated MTU fits the actual per-association carrier/FEC/Game budget, including explicit oversize-datagram behavior.
continuation_cursor.done_when: Stale range tests are corrected; LINK_INIT-to-activation enforces the canonical per-association transport budget; 1500/FEC/Game accepts LINK plaintext 1372 and rejects 1373 before transfer; FEC-off and multiple simultaneous association budgets are tested; oversize backend data has explicit tested behavior with a subsequent legal packet; real FEC + native DTLS + FakeTCP boundary validation passes for 1500 plus one smaller and one explicitly supported large-MTU case; no transport-integrity error is introduced.
continuation_cursor.next_atomic_action: Refresh live release/20260914-fec-baseline HEAD and this handoff, create a dedicated MTU fix branch from the refreshed release head, then trace one negotiated MTU from LINK_INIT through linkPolicyForInnerMTU/policy validation into association activation and the server serviceLoop. Identify the exact per-association enforcement point and write/repair the boundary tests before changing wire format or MTU constants.
